observations.observation: Combine metadata from several health catalogues while retaining a consistent interpretation of records.
Resolve ambiguity in whether biobank resources should be described as individual datasets or catalogues.
Make dataset identities stable and distinguishable across portals and consider a consistent description of data sources.
Enable users to narrow searches using multiple descriptive attributes.
Make it feasible for holders to produce rich descriptions without excessive administrative work.
Provide non-sensitive proxy or subset data so users can explore restricted holdings.
Describe provenance, population and collection purpose in metadata that can support AI-assisted discovery.

note: Eight curator summaries of needs and discussion topics. Not a verbatim candidate list or complete survey-response export. Excludes property resolutions, final draft and December mockups. Use only as a partial consolidation experiment.
